newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P cuts Samsung Electronics' long-term rating outlook. [Corrected 2:48 gmt]
newsitem.headline: S&P cuts Samsung Electronics' long-term rating outlook. [Corrected 2:48 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text from "long-term rating" to "long-term rating outlook").
Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had cut Samsung Electronics Co Ltd's long-term rating outlook to negative from stable.

S&P said the rating outlook cut was based on concerns that the currently deep and potentially protracted semiconductor industry downturn will cause the company to increasingly rely on debt to finance its rapid growth both domestically and internationally in the face of significantly reduced cash flow.

At the same time, S&P said it had affirmed the single A minus long-term rating and A2 commercial paper rating of Samsung Electronics and the commercial paper rating on its unit Samsung Electronics America.
